title: DAILY PROVISION
GOD IS FAITHFUL
end: The Provision Table — walk in God's daily provision
stock_queries: ancient stone table in soft light
flowing river over smooth river rocks
golden light hitting pine forest floor
cliffs at sunset with long shadows
quiet mountain path in morning light

scenes.a: As you calculate your limited resources for the week ahead, hear this holy promise.
Behold, I will rain bread from heaven for you.
And the people shall go out and gather a certain rate every day, that I may prove them, whether they will walk in my law, or no.
Lord, help me to gather only what I need for today, trusting that your hand will supply my requirements again tomorrow.
Remove my anxiety over the future and quiet my spirit as I walk in your law, resting in your perfect provision.
May my actions today reflect a heart that is fully dependent upon your grace for every single earthly necessity.
